body_markdown:
Effective June 7, 2026 the United States Domestic Fuel Surcharge Index shall be based on the following:


**Port of Load or Port of Discharge** **Surcharge Percentage**


Jacintoport, Houston, TX (Houston) 54.00%


Garden City Terminal, GA (Savannah) 54.00%


Gloucester Marine Terminal, NJ (Port of Philadelphia) 54.00%


Penn Terminals, Philadelphia, PA (Philadelphia) 54.00%


PortMiami & Port Everglades, FL (Miami) 54.00%


Port Newark, NJ (Newark) 54.00%


Port of New Orleans, LA (NOLA) 54.00%


Port of Wilmington, NC (Wilmington) 54.00%


Red Hook Container Terminal, Brooklyn, NY (Brooklyn) 54.00%


For more information about the United States Domestic Fuel Surcharge, visit our website:


[READ MORE](https://www.seaboardmarine.com/fuel/us-domestic-fuel-surcharge/)


Please note that all changes that do require a legal 30-day notice are correctly filed and announced in the respective Public Tariff. This advisory shows some of these changes as a courtesy to our valued customers. This published notice in no way replaces the application of the Public Tariff.
